value.syntax: # [doc = " Structured fields attached to a control-plane record."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , Serialize , Deserialize , PartialEq , Eq)] # [serde (tag = "type" , rename_all = "snake_case")] pub enum ControlPlaneFields { # [doc = " Help text returned by clap or a command-specific renderer."] Help { text : String } , # [doc = " Version string returned by clap or the command."] Version { version : String } , # [doc = " Details for an argv parsing or usage error."] UsageError { exit_code : u8 , clap_error_kind : String } , # [doc = " Details for stdout TTY refusal."] TtyRefusal { exit_code : u8 , stream : StandardStream } , # [doc = " Details for a panic diagnostic, including every available public string payload."] Panic { exit_code : u8 , thread : Option < String > , location : Option < String > , # [serde (skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] payload : Option < String > , } , }
